title: Chainguard is racing to fix trust in AI-built software - here's how | ZDNET
summary: Chainguard is advancing its AI-driven approach to secure software development by targeting open-core programs, GitHub Actions, and agent skills, with a focus on automating away traditional vulnerability cycles and achieving secure by design systems. The company's Chainguard Factory 2.0 has significantly reduced known vulnerabilities in customer environments.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights Chainguard's innovative efforts to enhance software security and automation, which is a positive development for the industry.
